title: ArchProfile card
description: One per-architecture / per-SKU hardware + policy card. The canonical arch identity is the bare sm_XX arch_id; the sku disambiguates cards sharing a compute capability. Fields that were never captured on local silicon use the research_gap object instead of a value.

build_arch_family.description: Compile-time fatbin slices; may include server-only tokens forbidden as deploy arch_ids.

latencies_cycles.description: Measured load-to-use latencies in SM cycles from the counter-free tools/pchase harness (clock64-timed, boost-invariant). Microbench-derived simulator INPUTS — never NCU counter values (Rule 1). Keys: l1_hit, l2_hit, dram, shared; unresolved probes (e.g. mshr_outstanding_misses) carry research_gap objects. provenance names the pchase static card + driver + host clock-lock state.

dram_bandwidth.description: Aggregate DRAM read-bandwidth covariate at the LOCKED operating point: peak_bytes_per_second (vendor bus-width x data-rate spec), locked_sm_clock_mhz / locked_mem_clock_mhz (the -lgc/-lmc protocol locks the latencies_cycles table was measured under), provenance. Vendor-documented + protocol-derived simulator INPUT — never an NCU value (Rule 1). Peak is a documented-default service-rate hypothesis until a locked-protocol bandwidth microbench supersedes it; cards without a locked operating point carry research_gap.
